study.question: Conditional on the unchanged feedback-derived task masks and auxiliary strata, how much click-AUC utility does explicit historical action-token content add beyond ad/context content, and does its removal interact with task-index residual routing?
study.hypothesis: The imported joint model has click AUC 0.666753547526167 versus DIN 0.6555440824200336 (difference 0.01120946510613341), while its cart/fav/buy AUCs are lower (0.778878/0.787612/0.757167 versus 0.849070/0.864897/0.870182). These are two inherited single-seed results, not action or routing contrasts. Source inspection finds action embeddings in every value summary and the activation scorer, mask-derived auxiliary feedback strata, and task-index residual-bank routing. Explicit token content may supply information beyond those fixed strata and item/context fields, especially with task-index adapters. Zeroing tokens may lower click AUC and sharing adapters may attenuate that loss. This is a conditional token-utility subquestion of the broader feedback question; unchanged action-derived masks preclude a total-feedback-removal conclusion.

nearest_work.difference: Retain the accepted source as the observed-token/task-routing factorial cell and utility control. New modules change only the token channel and/or residual-bank readout; the source is a complex inherited local model, not an independently established mechanism.

Archived primary text lines 250-277 describes target-dependent weighted-sum local activation without softmax normalization. We inherit that activation family through the accepted model, and study explicit feedback tokens and task-index residual routing at frozen compression and ownership, rather than claim a new DIN mechanism or exact paper reproduction.

Pinned benchmark source lines 123-169 initializes task-specific sequence hubs with action-derived multi_masks and uses layer-wise interaction/task heads. This study has no hub/broadcast layers: it replaces explicit token content and switches readout of an unchanged residual bank, retaining masks. Only the benchmark implementation is inspected; original INFNet paper detail is unavailable in the authorized cache, so priority and original-method equivalence remain unverified.

Authorized primary section 2.3 summarizes INFNet task hubs and HeMix fixed/conditioned queries. These are design context, not local performance evidence. We introduce neither hub exchange nor a new temporal query/token mixer.

study.proposed_difference: Submit four new standalone modules. Existing parent supplies A_T (observed token, task-index adapter); token_zero_task supplies Z_T; token_observed_shared supplies A_S; token_zero_shared supplies Z_S. The token_context_task cell C_T reuses the action embedding table for deterministic masked brand codes and tests a capacity/extra-content alternative. Zero mode substitutes zero IDs before embedding and then forces the whole embedded action channel to exact zero, so the original tokens cannot reach any summary/scorer/readout. Context mode also substitutes IDs before lookup and never uses observed tokens. Original task masks, their union, all compression assignments and visibility are unchanged byte-for-byte at source level. Shared mode executes all four adapters and averages outputs for each task input; only residual task-index selection is removed. It does not erase task-specific heads, auxiliary routing or gradient ownership. The source observed/task cell remains unchanged on disk and is reused only with matching source/config/protocol/data/seed. Full feedback deletion, both source-best utility references and an established context-only model are not available as imported evidence; no such results are invented. This first round cannot resolve their missing comparisons.
predictions: Primary estimands on full-population validation click AUC: D_T=A_T-Z_T; D_S=A_S-Z_S; routing effects R_A=A_T-A_S and R_Z=Z_T-Z_S; interaction I=D_T-D_S=R_A-R_Z. Positive D_T and positive I are the directional hypothesis; record all signs and raw values without selecting favorable contrasts.

If token information rather than simply an extra learned content channel matters under task routing, A_T should outperform C_T as well as Z_T. A_T-C_T is the replacement-controlled token contrast. C_T-Z_T estimates the utility of reactivating the extra channel with existing content, not action information.

Report every task AUC and unweighted logloss, auxiliary mean separately, total/embedding/dense parameters, training wall and allocated GPU seconds, examples/passes, peak memory, throughput and whole-batch p50/p95 latency using the host evaluator. Keep click AUC as selection metric.

Use inherited predeclared history bins empty/1-16/17-64/>64 and report sample/positive/negative counts. Behavior-composition exploratory slices must be predeclared from the provided masks (zero vs any cart/fav/buy history) and scored only if the host exposes approved slice support; do not manufacture unavailable per-user data. Other requested slices remain unavailable unless the host supports them.

At identical state in eval mode, zero/context cells must be invariant to changing action token IDs while masks and content are held fixed. Observed/task bridge through the common source with action_channel=observed and residual_routing=task must match parent outputs, gradients and persistent buffers on the host. Empty-history predictions at fixed eval state must match across interventions; differences after retraining can be parameter effects.

A single-seed nonzero effect is preliminary. Target three paired seeds for consequential contrasts later through the host, preserving the frozen seed in this submission. Use user-cluster paired bootstrap only where the authorized scorer exposes user clusters/predictions; otherwise disclose missing intervals.
falsifiers: D_T <= 0, or no reproducible positive token-removal loss over paired seeds, weakens incremental token utility. It cannot show all feedback is useless because action-derived masks remain.
I near zero or sign reversal across seeds weakens dependence of token utility on task-index residual routing. Lack of uncertainty estimates precludes a significance claim.
C_T matching/exceeding A_T weakens feedback-specific information as the cause; changed effective capacity, generic extra representation or optimization remains plausible even when Z_T is worse.

Any action-ID dependence in zero/context cells at fixed masks/content, leakage of target action/current labels, widened masks, source/config mismatch, non-finite outputs/gradients or changed learned construction invalidates interpretation until corrected through the authorized interface.
Different source/task-gradient ownership or Dice populations in a purported single-factor contrast invalidates that contrast. Unknown or failed execution is not negative scientific evidence.
alternative_explanations: Action-derived auxiliary mask union remains in both compression and Dice populations. Token deletion leaves coarse feedback information, so null effects can reflect redundancy rather than absence of feedback utility.

Zero cells retain the action table in the allocated count but its channel is inactive. Context replacement restores active table capacity without new parameters; row frequency, effective degrees of freedom, feature semantics and optimizer trajectory still differ.

The shared readout retains four learned adapters but averages them; their gradients, effective specialization and scale can differ from task-index routing. Equal allocated parameters and bank execution do not prove equal effective capacity or optimization.

Scratch retraining changes BatchNorm/Dice moments and all subsequent optimization. These are learned-predictor comparisons, not fixed-checkpoint causal information interventions or a decomposition of the DIN advantage.

The existing observed/task cell is a previously selected incumbent; winner selection and lack of independent repeated seeds can inflate apparent gains. The 0.01120946510613341 advantage over DIN is descriptive and cannot be assigned additively to the new contrasts.

Only two successful imported trajectories are authorized, with no failed/abandoned local records and no scoped agent-memory search hits. The inaccessible parent ancestry and other source bests provide no admissible result here. Retain every newly produced failure and null outcome in host receipts.

Auxiliary labels are 24h user/category/brand matches rather than ad-specific attribution; official_offline feedback may be immature at prediction time. Conclusions remain restricted to this benchmark protocol.

knowledge_assessments.rationale: Pinned benchmark forward inspected: task hubs explicitly use action-derived multi_masks. That motivates stating residual information after token deletion; there is no local evidence supporting adoption of a new hub architecture.

knowledge_assessments.falsifier: If the mask/content audit shows token erasure still reads observed IDs, the conditional intervention is invalid. Predictive utility requires the declared local contrasts, not the card.
